title: fix(website): keep scroll and plain-text search params
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Follow-up to #15958, part of landing #14472 in steps.

- Fix: typing in the Apps search or changing a filter no longer jumps the page to the top (`resetScroll: false`, as v2 already does)
- Fix: search values stay plain text. `?query=123` stays `123`, and typing `true` no longer writes `%22true%22`
- Route search validators become typed casts; the `text()` helper is gone

Verified against the pre-router build: Apps search keeps scrollY 600 (was reset to 0), and all 10 behaviour checks match (navigation, search replace, deep links, `?model=` preselect, unknown route, footer, api_key hash).

The same router setting lands on `feat/website-v2`, where Play keeps its inputs in the URL.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

gist.headline: Search stays put
gist.blurb: The Apps page stops jumping to the top when you search or change a filter. Search terms also stay plain text in the URL, with no surprise quotation marks.
gist.summary: Apps search and filter navigation now use `resetScroll: false`, while typed route casts keep values such as `?query=123` and `true` as plain text instead of adding encoded quotes.
gist.impact: Searching or filtering Apps preserves your scroll position, and URL search values remain readable for navigation and deep links.
